title: dev.qory.run.refused
description: The run did not start after the ping. Emitted in place of dev.qory.run.started, as the run's first event after the ping, heartbeats aside, and its last. It is always sent, like the ping, whatever events.types lists, and the runner waits up to fifteen seconds for its delivery. Every no-run after an accepted ping emits it, whatever stops the run. Events carry names and ids alone.

code.description: Why the run did not start: a refusal code of the runner, of qory, or of the server, the one a signed answer's body contained. integration_failed: an integration's describe or credential role did not start, exited non-zero or answered what its schema refuses. tool_not_started: a tool exited before it listened, or did not listen in time. start_failed: any other failure after the ping and before dev.qory.run.started, such as the wall, the image or the runtime's launch.

connection.description: The id of the connection the refusal concerns, for every refusal that concerns one: a run configuration's con_ id, or a connection id of the runner file.

names.description: The names the refusal concerns, names alone: variables, secrets, declarations, groups, or the integration's or the tool's name for integration_failed, tool_not_started and start_failed where there is one.

providers.description: With secret_unresolved, for an external reference: the providers tried, in their order.

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer, when the code came from the server, and with fetch_failed when the fetch answered.
